speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation, have a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes, and have abnormal lab results. To understand the cause of these symptoms, have you been feeling unusually tired, confused, or experiencing nausea recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely drug-induced or viral). The combination of jaundice, agitation (potential hepatic encephalopathy), and high-risk behaviors including drug use strongly points to liver failure. I need immediate confirmation with liver function tests and a viral hepatitis panel. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel, Viral_Hepatitis_Panel.
